day4_after_start.name: Me
day4_after_start.text: *After school. The bell rang. The classroom empties out. Everything I learned today swirls in my head.*

day4_after_start_2.name: Me
day4_after_start_2.text: *The sounds I heard beyond the basement door. Yuna's groan. Ms. Eunsu's key. ...The true face of this school.*

day4_after_start_3.name: Me
day4_after_start_3.text: *Sea is heading toward the student council room. Eunsu should be in the faculty office. Riin is in the nurse's office. ...Who do I go to first?*

day4_after_sea_route.name: Me
day4_after_sea_route.text: *I followed Sea to the student council room.*

day4_after_sea_2.name: Me
day4_after_sea_2.text: *Sea locks the door. Click. The sound of the lock echoed especially loud. In the empty hallway.*

day4_after_sea_3.name: Sea
day4_after_sea_3.text: I wanted it to be just us today.

day4_after_sea_4.name: Me
day4_after_sea_4.text: *Sea sits down. Her eyes are different from usual. Bloodshot. Traces of crying.*

day4_after_sea_5.name: Me
day4_after_sea_5.text: *Through the window, I can see the schoolyard. Since school's out, students are leaving in small groups. All with the same smile.*

day4_after_sea_7.name: Me
day4_after_sea_7.text: *Sea looks at me. For a long time. As if trying to memorize my face.*

day4_after_sea_10.name: Me
day4_after_sea_10.text: *Sea's lips tremble. She starts to speak, stops. Starts again, stops. On the third try, she opens her mouth.*

day4_after_sea_force.name: Me
day4_after_sea_force.text: *'Forget it.' How cruel that word is in this situation -- only Sea knows. Choices appear.*

day4_after_sea_accept.name: Me
day4_after_sea_accept.text: *...The choices changed. No — there was only one from the start.*

day4_after_sea_accept_3.name: Me
day4_after_sea_accept_3.text: *Sea looks out the window. The sunset paints the student council room in red.*

day4_after_sea_confess_3.text: Twelve times... Each time, in this student council room, you smiled and said, "I'll come again tomorrow." Each time, you told me, "Thank you." Each time, you said my lunchbox was delicious.
day4_after_sea_confess_3.name: Han Sea

day4_after_sea_confess_4.text: And each time... on the fifth day, you forgot me.
day4_after_sea_confess_4.name: Han Sea

day4_after_sea_confess_5.text: *Tears stream from Sea's eyes. She doesn't wipe them away.*
day4_after_sea_confess_5.name: Me

day4_after_sea_confess_6.text: The ninth time... you made me a bracelet. It had 'Sea' engraved on it. I still have it.
day4_after_sea_confess_6.name: Han Sea

day4_after_sea_confess_7.text: *Sea rolls up her sleeve. An old string bracelet is wrapped around her wrist. The string is frayed. As if it's years old.*
day4_after_sea_confess_7.name: Me

day4_after_sea_confess_8.text: The tenth time, you saw this and asked, 'It's pretty, who gave it to you?'
day4_after_sea_confess_8.name: Han Sea

day4_after_sea_confess_9.text: You made it for me. You just don't remember.
day4_after_sea_confess_9.name: Han Sea

day4_after_sea_12loop.name: Me
day4_after_sea_12loop.text: *Sea hugged me. Her hands tighten behind my back.*

day4_after_sea_12loop_2.name: Me
day4_after_sea_12loop_2.text: *Sea murmurs. Her lips close enough to brush my ear.*

day4_after_sea_12loop_6.name: Me
day4_after_sea_12loop_6.text: *Sea's body went rigid. She seems to realize what she just said.*

day4_after_sea_12loop_7.name: Me
day4_after_sea_12loop_7.text: *Seojin. The name on the third name tag. Park Seojin.*

day4_after_sea_12loop_9.name: Me
day4_after_sea_12loop_9.text: *Sea doesn't let go. If anything, she holds me tighter. Her shoulders are trembling.*

day4_after_sea_12loop_10.name: Me
day4_after_sea_12loop_10.text: *When she rolled up her sleeve, I saw it. An old thread bracelet on her wrist. The threads are frayed. Looks years old.*

day4_after_sea_12loop_11.name: Me
day4_after_sea_12loop_11.text: *...A name is engraved on it. 'Sea.' A handmade bracelet. -- In my handwriting.*

day4_after_sea_12loop_12.name: Me
day4_after_sea_12loop_12.text: *Sea noticed. That I'm looking at the bracelet.*

day4_after_ft_sea_pre.name: Me
day4_after_ft_sea_pre.text: *Sea grabbed my arm. I tried to get up, but she won't let go.*

day4_after_ft_sea.name: Sea
day4_after_ft_sea.text: ...Say whatever you want. Nothing's going to change anyway.

day4_after_ft_sea_post.name: Me
day4_after_ft_sea_post.text: *Sea let go. No matter what I said, her eyes never changed. Not sad, not angry -- just old resignation.*

day4_after_eunsu_route.name: Me
day4_after_eunsu_route.text: *I headed to the faculty office. I can't avoid this anymore. I need to ask directly.*

day4_after_eunsu_2.name: Me
day4_after_eunsu_2.text: *Eunsu sees me and sighs. A tired expression. Dark circles under her eyes. She's alone in the faculty office. All the other teachers have left their seats. -- Did they leave, or were they made to leave?*

day4_after_eunsu_4.name: Eunsu
day4_after_eunsu_4.text: You went all the way to the door?

day4_after_eunsu_4a.text: *The teacher speaks calmly as she pours coffee. Her hand doesn't tremble. As if she'd been preparing for this conversation.*
day4_after_eunsu_4a.name: Me

day4_after_eunsu_5.name: Me
day4_after_eunsu_5.text: *She makes coffee. Two cups. She sets one in front of me.*

day4_after_eunsu_6.name: Me
day4_after_eunsu_6.text: *...Two sugars, half cream. Exactly the same as what I put in mine yesterday at the faculty office.*

day4_after_eunsu_7.name: Me
day4_after_eunsu_7.text: *...I never told her. She only watched me do it once yesterday.*

day4_after_eunsu_8.name: Eunsu
day4_after_eunsu_8.text: That's right, isn't it? Your preference.

day4_after_eunsu_9.name: Me
day4_after_eunsu_9.text: *Teacher smiles. It is not the warm smile from Day 1, but relief: the kind shown when a controlled variable returns to its place.*

day4_after_eunsu_10.name: Me
day4_after_eunsu_10.text: *The desk drawer is half open. I can see Post-it notes inside. Dozens of them. Dense handwriting. -- All names. Different names. Some with lines crossed through them.*

day4_after_eunsu_11.name: Me
day4_after_eunsu_11.text: *On the bottom Post-it, my name. No line through it.*

day4_after_eunsu_13.name: Me
day4_after_eunsu_13.text: It's okay, {name}. Teacher will sort it out again.

day4_after_eunsu_14.name: Eunsu
day4_after_eunsu_14.text: *Teacher's hand stopped above my head, as if she had been about to pat me, then realized for herself how strange that was.*

day4_after_riin_route.name: Me
day4_after_riin_route.text: *I went to the nurse's office. Not for medicine. There's something I need to confirm.*

day4_after_riin_2.name: Me
day4_after_riin_2.text: *Riin is sitting at her desk. She was organizing documents. When I walked in -- her hand stopped. She flipped the papers over. Slowly. Casually. But I saw it. The title: 'S-13 Dosage Records.'*

day4_after_riin_4.name: Me
day4_after_riin_4.text: *The eyes watching me are different from usual. Guarded eyes. ...No, not guarded. Assessing. Eyes gauging what I know.*

day4_after_riin_5.name: Me
day4_after_riin_5.text: Riin. I went to the basement door in the old building.

day4_after_riin_5b.text: You're not trying to hide it anymore, right?
day4_after_riin_5b.name: Me

day4_after_riin_6.name: Me
day4_after_riin_6.text: *Silence. Three seconds. Riin's expression doesn't change. No surprise. No panic.*

day4_after_riin_8.name: Me
day4_after_riin_8.text: *One sentence. Calmly. As if -- she'd been waiting for this moment. Riin stands up. Checks the nurse's office door. Locks it.*

day4_after_riin_10.name: Me
day4_after_riin_10.text: I heard Yuna's voice from inside the door. And I saw Ms. Eunsu unlock the door with a key and go in.

day4_after_riin_11.name: Me
day4_after_riin_11.text: *Riin lets out a sigh. Long. Like setting down a burden she's been carrying.*

day4_after_riin_12.name: Riin
day4_after_riin_12.text: ...That was fast. Faster than the twelfth.

day4_after_riin_15.name: Me
day4_after_riin_15.text: *Riin reaches into her pocket and pulls something out. A key. A small metal key.*

day4_after_riin_16.name: Me
day4_after_riin_16.text: *She starts to hold it out to me -- then stops.*

day4_after_riin_18.name: Me
day4_after_riin_18.text: *She puts the key back in her pocket.*

day4_after_riin_21.name: Me
day4_after_riin_21.text: *Riin looks at me. For the first time -- with eyes that aren't a school nurse's.*

day4_after_riin_22.name: Riin
day4_after_riin_22.text: Don't do anything tonight. Don't tell anyone about this.

day4_after_riin_25.name: Riin
day4_after_riin_25.text: ...I'll buy you time. Just until tomorrow morning.

day4_after_riin_26.name: Me
day4_after_riin_26.text: *Riin looks out the window. The setting sun. The nurse's office is bathed in orange light.*

day4_after_riin_27.name: Riin
day4_after_riin_27.text: ...I can't do this anymore either. This.

day4_after_end.name: Me
day4_after_end.text: *The sun has set. The school sinks into darkness. Tomorrow is coming. The fifth day.*

day4_xover_yuna_1.text: *As I leave the classroom -- Yuna is standing in the hallway. She's been waiting.*

day4_xover_yuna_5.name: Yuna
day4_xover_yuna_5.text: Every time. Same face walks in. Says they don't know.

day4_xover_yuna_7.name: Yuna
day4_xover_yuna_7.text: They're all here. From number one to now.

day4_xover_yuna_9.text: *I looked at the album. Same uniform. Same hallway. Same face -- only the expressions differ. Twelve photos.*

day4_xover_yuna_10.text: *Yuna closed the album and walked away in silence.*

day4_xover_yuna_skip.text: *As I leave the classroom -- Yuna is standing in the hallway.*

day4_xover_yuna_skip_met.text: *As I leave the classroom -- Yuna is standing in the hallway.*

day4_xover_yuna_skip_3.text: *Yuna shook her head and walked away.*
